h1: Custom Full Color Cooling Sport Towels
metaTitle: Custom Full Color Cooling Sport Towels | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color cooling sport towels for events or teams. Vibrant, all-over prints at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Full color decoration on cooling sport towels allows you to reproduce logos, photos, or complex artwork with vivid detail and smooth gradients. Unlike one- or two-color screen printing, full color sublimation dyes the fabric so the design won't crack or peel—ideal for promotional giveaways at summer races, corporate wellness events, or outdoor team gear. The result is a soft, breathable towel that stays vibrant through repeated use and washing.
heroAltText: Custom full color cooling sport towels with vibrant sublimated logo displayed on blue and white towel
